design.intent: Recombine Cinder Crown's features into a relay: manual gap, one-use inversion, upper terrace, barrel flourish and final wide crossing.
design.signature: Two spring transfers with different purposes are separated by an upper bridge and recovery; the final crossing gets the largest coin budget.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Two distinct crests establish the relay rhythm.
Complete a manual gap before committing to the optional stunt branch.
Reveal the loop landmark and settle its approach.
Hold the optional loop longer, clear the explosive connector and recover on the fallback.
Normalize velocity before the spring replaces it.
A short vertical reveal transfers the route onto the upper terrace.
Offer a brief optional barrel flourish on the upper bridge with a clear landing.
Separate barrel landing from the long spring trigger and preview the far bank.
A 28-unit crossing resolves the relay in one wide camera sweep.
Descend into an extended empty finish boulevard after the last checkpoint.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
